changes.title: Chart zoom sail
items: Sailing from the sea chart flies you in: the camera glides to the island, its sigil settling onto its glowing dancefloor, then swoops down to its south coast before the night begins (any key skips)

changes.title: Chart archipelago
items: On the sea chart, each island's land and lakes follow its place on the compass, blending between neighbours: ice in the far north, lava in the volcanic east, oases in the southern desert, deep cliff-walled sinkholes in the western jungle, and glacial tarns, terraced, steaming hot springs, rainbow hot pools and lily ponds between; an island on a border has lakes of both kinds
The sea chart shows the islands at their true sizes, packed over the whole sea, each coast following its neighbour's across a narrow strait

changes.title: Archipelago v3
items: The sea chart has much more open sea: islands sit further apart, never closer than a wide strait, with the phases mixed together
Islands turn to fit their neighbours, arms into bays, and the outer islands reach their arms out to sea
